description: Dry-run a commerce pricing policy against an item and competitor observations you supply, and see the price it would propose and why. Nothing is saved. Needs a Last Price credential with commerce proposal draft scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

item.description: The catalog item: its id, sku, price and attributes, as list_commerce_catalog shows one.

marketplace.description: The marketplace the item is sold on, when the policy scopes by marketplace.

observations.description: Competitor observations for the item, as list_commerce_observations shows them. Defaults to none.

policy_id.description: The policy id, as list_commerce_policies gives it.

name: test_commerce_policy
